tasks.title: Supplier archive CRUD, pagination, and validation
acceptance: Supplier archive supports create, edit, detail if needed by UI, and paginated query through REST APIs.

Supplier duplicate or invalid state errors use the project global exception shape.

dev_plan: Implement supplier entity/table, DTOs, repository, service, and controller endpoints.
Apply validation annotations or shared validation helper usage consistently at API boundaries.
Keep business logic in service layer and persistence concerns in repository layer.
test_plan: Unit or slice tests cover create success, edit success, paginated query, validation failure, and representative business error.
Tests assert global exception response shape for invalid supplier input.
review_plan: Check validation is declarative or shared-tool based, not duplicated manually in controllers.
Check pagination inputs are bounded and responses are stable.
Check supplier changes do not alter preset common utilities.

dev_plan: Implement category and product entities/tables, DTOs, repositories, services, and controllers.
Protect referential rules such as product category existence and category/product uniqueness as service logic.
Use consistent pagination request and response contracts from the foundation.

verification: Category and product API tests pass.

tasks.title: Purchase inbound document workflow
acceptance: Purchase inbound documents support create, edit where business status permits, and paginated query through REST APIs.
Inbound document lines reference valid suppliers and products and validate quantity, unit cost, and totals.
Creating or confirming inbound documents increases realtime inventory according to the selected business status model.
Invalid inbound state transitions and invalid line data use global exception and validation response patterns.
dev_plan: Implement purchase inbound header and line persistence model.
Implement service-layer transaction boundaries for document creation/editing and inventory updates.
Expose REST endpoints needed by PC admin create/edit/page flows.
test_plan: Tests cover inbound create success, paginated query, validation failure, invalid product or supplier reference, and inventory increase.
Tests cover edit restrictions or update behavior according to implemented document status rules.
review_plan: Check inventory updates are transactional with document writes.
Check money and quantity precision choices are explicit.
Check no controller contains document accounting logic.

tasks.title: Sales outbound billing and stock-out workflow
acceptance: Sales outbound documents support create, edit where business status permits, and paginated query through REST APIs.
Outbound lines reference valid products and validate quantity, unit sale price, and totals.
Creating or confirming outbound documents decreases realtime inventory and rejects insufficient stock.
Sales validation, insufficient stock, and invalid state errors reuse global exception and validation mechanisms.
dev_plan: Implement sales outbound header and line persistence model.
Implement service-layer transaction boundaries for stock deduction and document persistence.
Expose REST endpoints needed by PC admin create/edit/page flows.
test_plan: Tests cover outbound create success, paginated query, validation failure, insufficient inventory, and inventory decrease.
Tests cover edit restrictions or update behavior according to implemented document status rules.
review_plan: Check insufficient inventory cannot produce negative stock.
Check sales document and inventory movement are updated atomically.
Check no preset common utility files changed.

tasks.title: Realtime inventory accounting service and query APIs
acceptance: Inventory balance or movement model supports realtime quantity calculation per product.
Purchase inbound increases inventory and sales outbound decreases inventory through a single service contract.
Inventory query REST API supports paginated lookup suitable for the PC admin UI.
Inventory logic prevents negative stock and reports business errors through the global exception shape.
dev_plan: Implement inventory persistence and service contract before outbound stock deduction depends on it.
Expose paginated inventory query endpoints.
Ensure inbound and outbound services call the same inventory accounting service.
test_plan: Tests cover initial stock, inbound increase, outbound decrease, insufficient stock rejection, and paginated inventory query.
Tests assert deterministic realtime balances after a sequence of purchase and sales operations.
review_plan: Check inventory accounting is centralized and transactional.
Check realtime query does not duplicate inconsistent calculations.
Check concurrency assumptions are documented if optimistic or database locking is used.
verification: Inventory service and API tests pass.
Purchase and sales tests still pass against the shared inventory service.

tasks.title: Slow-moving product statistics report
acceptance: Slow-moving report REST API returns paginated products with inventory and last sale or movement evidence.
Report supports a configurable or request-level threshold such as no sales within N days.
Report validates query parameters and uses global validation and exception responses.
Report data is derived from inventory and sales data without introducing inconsistent duplicate stock values.
dev_plan: Define slow-moving criteria with a simple request parameter and sensible default.
Implement repository query and service mapping for slow-moving report rows.
Expose REST endpoint for PC admin report page.
test_plan: Tests cover products with recent sales, products without sales beyond threshold, pagination, and invalid threshold validation.
Tests assert report output includes fields needed by the frontend report table.
review_plan: Check report criteria are transparent and testable.
Check query performance is reasonable for a first implementation.
Check report does not mutate inventory state.

tasks.title: PC admin UI pages, forms, pagination, and validation
acceptance: PC admin UI includes supplier archive, category archive, product archive, purchase inbound, sales outbound, realtime inventory, and slow-moving report pages.
Each maintenance page supports add, edit, paginated query, and client-side form validation aligned with backend rules.
Document pages support line-item editing for purchase inbound and sales outbound with clear validation feedback.
Inventory and slow-moving report pages support paginated table views.
Frontend uses REST API contracts from backend tasks and handles global error responses consistently.
dev_plan: Create the minimal frontend scaffold needed for a PC management console.
Implement route/navigation structure for all required business modules.
Implement reusable table, form, pagination, and API client patterns only where repeated by required pages.
Wire form validation and error display against backend API contracts.

Verify API client behavior against backend error response shape.
Record frontend build and test commands for QA.
review_plan: Check UI covers every required module and workflow.
